1: // Simple canvas game based on IDEA.md – Cosmic Collector
2: // Assumes an existing <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Fit canvas to window
7:   const resize = () => {
8:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
9:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
10:   };
11:   resize();
12:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
13: 
14:   // Game state
15:   const state = {
16:     score: 0,
17:     shields: 3,
18:     objects: [], // falling debris
19:     lastSpawn: 0,
20:     spawnInterval: 800, // ms
21:     player: { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 60, w: 40, h: 40 },
22:     keys: { left: false, right: false },
23:     mouseX: null,
24:     gameOver: false,
25:   };
26: 
27:   // Enhanced background with gradient and twinkling stars
28:   const stars = Array.from({ length: 100 }, () => ({
29:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
30:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
31:     r: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
32:     speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
33:   }));
34: 
35:   const drawStars = () => {
36:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
37:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
38:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
39:     stars.forEach(s => {
40:       ctx.beginPath();
41:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
42:       ctx.fill();
43:       s.y += s.speed;
44:       if (s.y > canvas.height) s.y = 0;
45:     });
46:   };
47: 
48:   // Input handling – mouse moves ship horizontally, arrow keys as fallback
49:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
50:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
51:     state.mouseX = e.clientX - rect.left;
52:   });
53:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
54:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') state.keys.left = true;
55:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') state.keys.right = true;
56:   });
57:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
58:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') state.keys.left = false;
59:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') state.keys.right = false;
60:   });
61: 
62:   // Object types – gold, fuel, tool (point values), asteroid (hazard)
63:   const TYPES = [
64:     { type: 'gold', color: 'gold', points: 10 },
65:     { type: 'fuel', color: 'lime', points: 5 },
66:     { type: 'tool', color: 'cyan', points: 8 },
67:     { type: 'asteroid', color: 'red', points: 0, hazard: true },
68:   ];
69: 
70:   const spawnObject = () => {
71:     const t = TYPES[Math.floor(Math.random() * TYPES.length)];
72:     const size = t.hazard ? 30 : 20;
73:     state.objects.push({
74:       x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
75:       y: -size,
76:       w: size,
77:       h: size,
78:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
79:       ...t,
80:     });
81:   };
82: 
83:   const update = delta => {
84:     if (state.gameOver) return;
85:     // player movement
86:     if (state.mouseX !== null) {
87:       state.player.x = state.mouseX - state.player.w / 2;
88:     } else {
89:       if (state.keys.left) state.player.x -= 5;
90:       if (state.keys.right) state.player.x += 5;
91:     }
92:     // keep within bounds
93:     state.player.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(state.player.x, canvas.width - state.player.w));
94: 
95:     // spawn objects
96:     const now = Date.now();
97:     if (now - state.lastSpawn > state.spawnInterval) {
98:       spawnObject();
99:       state.lastSpawn = now;
100:     }
101: 
102:     // update objects and check collisions
103:     state.objects = state.objects.filter(o => {
104:       o.y += o.speed;
105:       // collision detection
106:       const collides =
107:         o.x < state.player.x + state.player.w &&
108:         o.x + o.w > state.player.x &&
109:         o.y < state.player.y + state.player.h &&
110:         o.y + o.h > state.player.y;
111:       if (collides) {
112:         if (o.hazard) {
113:           state.shields -= 1;
114:           if (state.shields <= 0) state.gameOver = true;
115:         } else {
116:           state.score += o.points;
117:         }
118:         return false; // remove collided object
119:       }
120:       // keep onscreen
121:       return o.y < canvas.height;
122:     });
123:   };
124: 
125:   const draw = () => {
126:     drawStars();
127:     // draw player ship (simple triangle)
128:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
129:     ctx.beginPath();
130:     const p = state.player;
131:     ctx.moveTo(p.x + p.w / 2, p.y);
132:     ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + p.h);
133:     ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.w, p.y + p.h);
134:     ctx.closePath();
135:     ctx.fill();
136: 
137:     // draw falling objects
138:     state.objects.forEach(o => {
139:       ctx.fillStyle = o.color;
140:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
141:     });
142: 
143:     // UI: score & shields
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
145:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
146:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${state.score}`, 10, 30);
147:     ctx.fillText(`Shields: ${state.shields}`, 10, 60);
148:     if (state.gameOver) {
149:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
150:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
151:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
152:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
153:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
154:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
155:     }
156:   };
157: 
158:   let lastTime = 0;
159:   const loop = timestamp => {
160:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
161:     lastTime = timestamp;
162:     update(delta);
163:     draw();
164:     if (!state.gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165:   };
166:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167: })();

(End of file - total 167 lines)
</content>
